capabilities.title: Define multi-step agent swarms, plugins, hooks, and automation through a broad orchestration runtime
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md CLI, swarm, plugin, MCP, hooks, daemon, and agent orchestration surfaces
capabilities.reason: Nexus intentionally exposes a small governed five-agent runtime. An arbitrary executable agent DSL, plugin host, hooks, and daemon would widen authority beyond the current typed tool and approval policies.

capabilities.title: Visual flow diagram for agent workflows: runtime graph showing step progress
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md orchestration status and swarm monitoring surfaces

capabilities.title: Conditional branching in agent flows: if/else logic based on agent outputs
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md adaptive coordination and workflow automation features
capabilities.reason: Model-output-driven branching could silently widen an advisory request into new actions. Nexus keeps routing deterministic and requires MAX or the operator to review handoffs before choosing another lane.

capabilities.title: Built-in retry and exponential backoff policy for agent steps
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md fault-tolerant orchestration, recovery, and daemon lifecycle features
capabilities.reason: Generic retries are unsafe for mutating or externally visible agent tools because replay may duplicate effects. Nexus limits automatic backoff to provider-health circuit breaking and leaves failed specialist handoffs visible for explicit review.
